patronOf.en-US: Jesus, Mary and Joseph at Nazareth
patronOf.pt-BR: Jesus, Maria e José em Nazaré

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Our God has appeared on the earth, and lived among us.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nosso Deus foi visto na terra e com os homens conviveu.

meta.face: St. Joseph as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about forty with a LONG OVAL face — a straight nose, gentle dark-brown eyes under level brows, a quiet mouth; full dark-brown curly hair to the nape and a short full dark-brown beard; a green tunic and an ochre-brown mantle. The boy Jesus: the Christ Child's face as in recurring-figures.md, lengthened to about seven — a softly rounded face with full cheeks, a high rounded forehead, a small straight nose, large clear brown eyes, a small rosy mouth, golden-brown curls to the ears, a plain gold halo; an eager, trusting look up at Joseph. Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md: a young woman of about twenty-five with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre under a white inner veil and a blue mantle drawn over the head.
meta.basis: The hidden life at Nazareth (Lk 2:39-40, 51-52) in the tradition of the carpenter's workshop, as in Murillo's Holy Family with a Little Bird and the many workshop scenes of the Holy Family, with the three faces kept from the recurring figures.
